key_insight: Random splits can reward recipe memorisation in perovskite solar-cell models, while provenance-grouped evaluation better tests generalisation.
engineering_relevance: Evaluating models on unseen institutions and future discoveries can better guide model selection for solar-cell optimisation.
method: Map institutional provenance in the Perovskite Database.
Apply grouped splits that progressively isolate duplicate devices, publications and institutions.
Benchmark 13 models and analyse feature importance.
evidence_signal: Nearly two-thirds of curated devices share an exact recipe with another; tree ensembles lead on random splits, but composition-aware neural models excel on unseen institutions and future discoveries.
watch_item: Reliable implementation depends on accurate recipe deduplication and publication-to-institution provenance mapping.
paper_title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
